newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast spot prods mixed amid NYMEX collapse.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast spot prods mixed amid NYMEX collapse.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices were mixed early as the NYMEX shrank from its steep gains in Tuesday's market.
"Everything generally is a little weaker," a broker said. "It's pretty much (New York Mercantile Exchange) driven."
NYMEX front-month gasoline collapsed from its Tuesday rally, dropping 1.33 cents a gallon at 1145 PST, to 67.80 cents.
As trade for second-cycle gasoline ended in Los Angeles, bids stood a half-cent higher at 67.50/68.50 cents a gallon, while bids for conventional material rose the same amount.
CARB-grade diesel in L.A. dropped a half cent to 73.50/74.50 cents a gallon. Prices fell under pressure from falling heating oil futures, which dropped around 1.02 cents at 1149 PST.
